mapper.sql: frd_screen_id, placement_mode, structure_id, menu_path_key, anchor_screen_id, screen_kind, status, source, development_file_name, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: select p.frd_screen_id, p.placement_mode, p.structure_id, p.menu_path_key, p.anchor_screen_id, p.screen_kind, p.status, p.source, p.development_file_name, p.updated_at, p.updated_by from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_ia_placement p join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen s on s.id = p.frd_screen_id where s.frd_id = #{frdId} and s.excluded_at is null order by s.created_at, s.id

select p.frd_screen_id, p.placement_mode, p.structure_id, p.menu_path_key, p.anchor_screen_id, p.screen_kind, p.status, p.source, p.development_file_name, p.updated_at, p.updated_by from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_ia_placement p join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen s on s.id = p.frd_screen_id join builder.adk_builder_frd f on f.id = s.frd_id where f.project_id = #{projectId} and p.development_file_name = #{developmentFileName}
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_ia_placement (frd_screen_id, placement_mode, structure_id, menu_path_key, anchor_screen_id, screen_kind, status, source, development_file_name, updated_at, updated_by) values (#{frdScreenId}, #{placementMode}, #{structureId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuPathKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{anchorScreenId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{screenKind}, #{status}, #{source}, #{developmentFileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) on conflict (frd_screen_id) do update set placement_mode = excluded.placement_mode, structure_id = excluded.structure_id, menu_path_key = excluded.menu_path_key, anchor_screen_id = excluded.anchor_screen_id, screen_kind = excluded.screen_kind, status = excluded.status, source = excluded.source, development_file_name = coalesce(excluded.development_file_name, adk_builder_frd_screen_ia_placement.development_file_name), updated_at = excluded.updated_at, updated_by = excluded.updated_by
